I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted the Osprey rollout update for Quarrendon Freight Lines. Today is 14 October 2026, so a 26 August deadline this year has already passed. I asked her whether she meant 26 August 2027 or whether the date is wrong.

As she asked, I'm not doing anything else on the rollout until she confirms the date.
